audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the final eight Solarion tabletop-game branch records, including both healer targets, all wizard and warrior boss choices, the capsule escape, and the closing dialogue. Every narration line, embedded action choice, spell name, fantasy title, combat outcome, repeated victory state, and character reaction was reviewed in sequence and against every reachable branch. Event commands, branch keys, actors, movement, timing, prior-choice conditions, response delimiters, placeholders, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Together with the two preceding batches, all Sebastian Room records are covered. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
